topic: A contract that needs three signatures in two countries — how long does that take your business right now?
format: State the uncomfortable truth about how most Oman businesses handle this problem — be specific and honest, not preachy
post:
11 days. Two cities. One contract still waiting on a signature — while someone on your team is forwarding the same PDF through WhatsApp for the fourth time.

That's not a rare situation. That's Tuesday.

Most businesses in Oman with 10–50 employees don't talk about this because it feels too small to complain about. But those 11 days don't just disappear. They're a project that slipped. A hire that dragged. A client who stopped responding and never explained why.
